subject: MAP: acceptance window drift & proposed stabilization plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: acceptance window drift & proposed stabilization plan

Alex —

Thanks again for the candor this morning. I understand the security review added an unplanned gating item and that procurement is now looking at a revised internal PO target. We anticipated some risk around the final acceptance window, so I want to put a short, clear path on the table to keep momentum without overcommitting.

Proposal (quick):
- Option A (soft rebaseline): Move acceptance target from 2025-11-14 to 2025-11-28; Redwood provides a 7-day staging window and priority onboarding slot.
- Option B (accelerated support + conditional credit): Keep the 11/14 date, Redwood provides a temporary test environment and a 10% one-time credit on first-month usage if PO is signed by 11/07.

Can you confirm which option looks feasible from your side? If neither works, tell me your new target and we’ll put together a single-line MAP amendment you can circulate to Procurement. I’ve attached the redlines to the MAP (MAP_v2_redlines.pdf) showing the two options.

Goal is to avoid drift that forces a re-architected rollout plan. Happy to jump on a 15-min sync later today.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v2_redlines.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@helixhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@helixhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: acceptance window drift & proposed stabilization plan

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear options. Short answer: procurement is the blocker — their legal/security packet processing has extended and our PO timeline is now targeting 11/25. That makes Option A (11/28) look more realistic than the accelerated Option B.

A few asks from my side:
- Can Redwood guarantee the staging slot and priority onboarding if we confirm by 11/10?
- Can you provide a brief statement we can attach to the PO explaining the impact of a one-two week slip on the go-live schedule (so our internal approvers see the tradeoffs)?

I’m attaching the procurement intake they sent over in case it helps (PO_request.pdf). We’ll aim for a 11/10 internal sign-off to lock the MAP amendment.

Team —

Looping you in. Helix procurement pushed the PO target to 11/25 (internal sign-off by 11/10). They prefer the soft rebaseline to 11/28. Risks if we accept:
- Acceptance slip may shift premium onboarding dates and impact the Nov feature release cadence (customer wants to keep parity with original cutover).
- If we offer credits too liberally, we set a precedent across similar mid-market deals.

Ask: recommend we approve Option A with two guardrails: (1) commit to priority staging if Helix confirms by 11/10, (2) add a clause in the MAP amendment that re-opens credit discussion only if delay > 21 days from original acceptance date. Also, need procurement/finance to clear a small credit contingency if we later need to escalate.

If you’re aligned I’ll send a single-email MAP amendment and an impact note for their PO approvers.

—Marcus
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: acceptance window drift & proposed stabilization plan

Marcus —

Agree with Option A + guardrails. From a pricing/finance perspective I can approve a conditional credit policy:
- If Helix signs the amended MAP and PO by 11/10: no credit, priority staging guaranteed.
- If Helix signs the PO by 11/17 (but after 11/10) and go-live shifts to <= 21 days from original acceptance, offer a one-time 7% credit (not to exceed $15k).
- Any request for credits >7% or retro credits requires VP approval.

I’ve attached a short matrix to show the thresholds (pricing_concession_matrix.csv). If Marcus wants to offer the 7% as a fast close lever, we should note the cap and the sign-by date in the MAP amendment.

Neha
Director, Revenue Operations
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Alex —

Appreciate the update and for surfacing procurement’s timeline. Per internal alignment we’ll proceed with Option A (soft rebaseline) with the guardrails below:

Agreed plan (summary):
- Revised acceptance date: 2025-11-28 (MAP amendment attached: MAP_v2_final.docx).
- Helix confirms MAP amendment and PO by 2025-11-10 to secure priority staging and onboarding.
- If PO arrives between 2025-11-11 and 2025-11-17 and acceptance slips but remains within 21 days of the original 11/14 date, Redwood will offer a one-time 7% credit up to $15k.
- Any credit requests beyond the stated cap require VP approval.

I’ve also attached a one-page impact note you can include with your PO to explain how a two-week slip affects the targeted feature rollout and recommended staging steps. Link to signed MAP (DocuSign) is here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-map-v2 — happy to route a DocuSign copy to Procurement.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm whether Procurement can commit to the internal 11/10 sign-by. If yes, we’ll send the formal amendment for signature.
- Helix: if procurement needs a brief exec note, tell me who to address and we’ll attach the impact brief.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
